newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids drop.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids drop.

text.p: Slight losses in spring wheat on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange weighed on some cash bids for dark northern spring wheat Monday, merchandisers said.
"The losses in the futures and just a general lack of demand, that is why we're a little weaker today," said one Montana cash dealer.
Ongoing transportation problems related to the extremely cold temperatures and snow continued to provide prices with support, dealers said.
Temperatures in Montana, including the wind chill, were as low as 40 degrees Fahrenheit below zero, dealers there said.
White wheat dealers said activity in cash markets Monday was also quiet.
"Things are at an absolute standstill," a dealer in Oregon said.
